title: 第29章 能不能看准了再劈
novel_title: 伪装隐世仙族后，大佬疯狂跪舔我
content_zh:
南落城上，积聚的劫云愈发浓厚，百姓们出门看到这一幕，心中困惑，今天这是怎么了，先是神秘异象，又是劫云罩顶，真不知道上面这些大佬在干什么。

    第一次看见别人渡劫，微生璃月有点好奇，在几位师兄师姐和师父一同苏醒，并挪到屋外空旷地界准备挨雷劈之后，她让天一帮自己找了个安全地方，准备吃瓜看戏。

    为了避免自己的吃瓜意味太浓，她还喊了现场唯一悠闲的几个人跟自己一起：“四师姐，老祖，还有谢家主，我这边的视野宽阔，你们要不要过来一起。”

    三人里就濮阳明珠跟微生璃月相处时间最长，见小师妹主动喊自己，立马走了过去，自然地拿起天一准备的另一份灵果就开始啃。

    一般这种，都是小师妹给她们准备的。

    剩下两人对视一眼，有瓜吃，去了！

    谢闻笙本就是谢家家主，平日里修炼资源不少，但像微生小姐这般，极品灵果毫不限制的吃法，他也没这个待遇。

    至于老祖，光看他身上这个衣衫褴褛的样子，就知道他平时没吃过什么好东西。

    相比之下，跟着小师妹待了一段时间后的濮阳明珠，在面对这些灵瓜灵果时，竟比这两人淡定。

    “老祖，您老经验多，你说我师父和几位师兄师姐，谁能最先结束雷劫。”微生璃月对着正在疯狂吃瓜的老祖发出真诚提问。

    四个人的劫云加在一起，她感觉这天黑得像是能滴出墨来，云层中，轰隆隆的雷声震动得土地都在晃动，已经可以预估到等会儿的场面会有多惨烈。

    “这……不清楚。”

    “你师父是极品变异雷灵根，每提升一个境界都需要渡雷劫，估摸着也被劈习惯了，问题不大，就是时间不确定。长泽虽是极品天火灵根，天赋异禀，但早年间在秘境伤到了灵根本源，会发疯，也不确定。

    你二师姐身子弱，这金丹劫云要是能过，身体也不知道能不能撑得住。要是真让我猜，应该就是那毛头小子，身体硬朗得很。”老祖吃东西空出的手指向林不语。

    就是这四人一起渡劫，他也不确定等会儿会发生什么。

    “四师兄啊……我觉得也是。”微生璃月点头应和。

    四师兄虽是个剑修，但在炼体一道上颇具心得，上次被她的月神殿打飞，也只是衣角微脏，修养两天就恢复了，身子确实壮实。

    只是……
content_en:
On Nanluo City, the accumulated calamity clouds became thicker and thicker. When the people went out and saw this scene, they were confused. What happened today? First there was a mysterious vision, and then there was the calamity cloud covering the top. I really don't know what the big guys above are doing.

It was the first time she saw someone else going through a tribulation. Weisheng Liyue was a little curious. After several senior brothers and sisters woke up with her master and moved to the open space outside the house to prepare for being struck by lightning, she asked Tianyi to help her find a safe place to eat melon and watch a show.

In order to avoid being too overly concerned, she also called the only leisurely people present to join her: "Fourth Senior Sister, Ancestor, and Patriarch Xie, I have a broad view here, do you want to come over and join me?"

Among the three of them, Puyang Mingzhu and Weisheng Liyue spent the longest time together. When they saw their junior sister calling him, they immediately walked over, naturally picked up another spiritual fruit prepared by Tianyi and started to eat.

Usually these kind of things are prepared for them by their junior sisters.

The remaining two people looked at each other and thought, let's go!

Xie Wensheng is the head of the Xie family, and he usually has a lot of resources for cultivation, but like Miss Wei Sheng, who can eat the best spiritual fruits without restrictions, he doesn't have the same treatment.

As for the ancestor, just by looking at the ragged appearance on his body, you can tell that he has never eaten anything good.

In contrast, Puyang Mingzhu, who had stayed with her junior sister for a while, was actually calmer than these two people when facing these spirit melons and spirit fruits.

"Ancestor, you have a lot of experience. Who among my master and several senior brothers and sisters can end the thunder tribulation first?" Weisheng Liyue asked a sincere question to the ancestor who was eating melon crazily.

Adding together the calamity clouds of the four people, she felt that the sky was so dark that it seemed like it could drip out of ink. In the clouds, the rumble of thunder shook the ground, and she could already predict how tragic the scene would be later.

"That's... unclear."

"Your master has the best mutated thunder spirit root. Every time you advance to a higher level, you need to go through thunder tribulations. I guess you are used to being hacked. The problem is not big, but the time is uncertain. Although Nagasawa has the best sky fire spirit root and is extremely talented, he injured the source of the spirit root in the secret realm in his early years. He will go crazy, and there is no certainty.

Your second senior sister is weak. If you can survive this golden elixir tribulation, you don't know if your body can withstand it.If I had to guess, it would be that young boy with a very tough body."The ancestor's free hand after eating pointed at Lin Buyu.

Even if these four people go through the tribulation together, he is not sure what will happen later.

"Fourth Senior Brother... I think so." Weisheng Liyue nodded in agreement.

Although the fourth senior brother is a sword cultivator, he has considerable experience in body training. The last time he was knocked away by her Moon Temple, his clothes were only slightly stained. He recovered within two days of training and his body is indeed strong.
